summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide the infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale, going well beyond what a simple hosted model API offers. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune custom models, require reproducible pipelines, governance, and production-grade MLOps across teams; a model API alone suffices when you only consume pretrained models (e.g., LLM inference) without owning the training lifecycle. The landscape is split between cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), data-centric lakehouse platforms (Databricks with MLflow + Mosaic AI), and specialized AutoML/MLOps tools (DataRobot, H2O.ai, Weights & Biases, Modal).

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage usage (training instances, hosting endpoints, notebooks); no upfront license.
platforms.best_for: Organizations where AWS is the strategic cloud and AWS-native infrastructure, security, deployment, and application integration are priorities.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, training hours, prediction nodes, and token usage for foundation models.
platforms.best_for: Teams on Google Cloud wanting unified AutoML, custom training, and access to Gemini and foundation models via Model Garden.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute usage; integrated with Azure billing, no separate license.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem wanting OpenAI/Foundry integration and Copilot alignment.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute; multi-cloud.
platforms.best_for: Teams needing a unified data, analytics, ML, and AI governance layer with multi-cloud flexibility.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; seat/usage-based paid tiers; enterprise plans for self-hosting.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration on top of any training stack.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance and less hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and managed cloud.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable ML plus LLM capabilities.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing (CPU/GPU/memory); generous free credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: MLflow (open source)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed hosting via Databricks or cloud providers.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, vendor-neutral standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + AutoTrain + Inference Endpoints)
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription; usage-based Inference Endpoints and Spaces; enterprise plans.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open models who need a shared hub for training, fine-tuning, and deploying transformers and LLMs.

platforms.name: ClearML
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; paid Pro and enterprise tiers.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source end-to-end MLOps stack with orchestration and compute management.
